scripts.preflight: bun run lint && bun run typecheck && bun run test
scripts.lint: turbo run lint && bun run scripts:lint
scripts.format: oxfmt && bun run scripts:format && (cd apps/rust && cargo fmt || true)
scripts.test: turbo run test && bun run test:scripts
scripts.test:coverage: (cd apps/web && bun run test:coverage) && (cd apps/nest-api && bun run test:cov) && (cd packages/logger && bun run test:coverage) && (cd apps/mobile && bun run test) && (cd apps/rust && bun run test) && bun run test:scripts
scripts.ci:lint: bun run lint && bun run architecture:check
scripts.scripts:lint: shellcheck scripts/bash/*.sh scripts/bash/tests/*.sh scripts/git-hooks/*.sh scripts/architecture/*.sh && (ruff check scripts/python 2>/dev/null || true)
scripts.scripts:format: shfmt -i 4 -w scripts/bash/*.sh scripts/bash/tests/*.sh scripts/git-hooks/*.sh scripts/architecture/*.sh || true
